issue: New entry does not persist across page reload
actual: Added entry 'QA Test Entry' (Priority 5, Due Date Sep 1 2026, Completed Yes) appeared immediately in both views and count went from 5 to 6 entries. After reloading the page (http://localhost:6074/), the table reverted to the original 5 seed entries and the QA Test Entry was gone entirely (also the custom 'Notes' field added earlier was lost). Data is not persisted to storage.

evidence: Opened Fields dialog, added new field 'Notes' with type Text via the type combobox (options: Text, Number, Date, Checkbox). New 'Notes' column immediately appeared in the table header and as a labeled field on every card in Card view, and later in the Add Entry form.

Add Entry form accepted text (Task Name='QA Test Entry'), number (Priority=5), date (Due Date=2026-09-01 shown as 'Sep 1, 2026'), and checkbox (Completed toggled to Yes). After submit, entry displayed with all these values correctly in both Table and Card views.
Switched from Table to Cards and back; all 6 entries (including newly added QA Test Entry) and their field values (Priority, Due Date, Completed, Notes) remained identical across both views.

Field type combobox in Configure Fields dialog clearly lists 'Text', 'Number', 'Date', 'Checkbox' each with icon+label. Add Entry form rendered type-appropriate controls: textbox for Text, spinbutton for Number, date input for Date, checkbox toggle for Checkbox.

Entry form checkbox toggled between unchecked 'No' and checked 'Yes' with clear checkmark icon. Table view renders 'check' icon (text-success color) for true and 'x' icon (text-muted-foreground) for false. Card view shows 'Yes'/'No' text with matching icon.

Table: sorted by Priority ascending then toggled to descending (order 3,2,2,1,1) via column header click. Cards view separately sorted by Due Date ascending (Jan14,15,18,20,25). Switching back to Table showed it still 'Sorted by Priority (descending)' with the same order, confirming independent per-view sort state retention.

Selecting 'Priority' from Sort menu immediately reordered rows; Sort button label changed to 'Priority', column header showed a direction icon, and footer status text read 'Sorted by Priority (ascending)'/'(descending)' after toggling. App remained fully interactive after each sort action.
Before and after sorting by Priority (asc/desc) and Due Date, entry count remained 5 and all field values per entry (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed) were unchanged — only row order changed.

With no field sort active, dragged 'Design new landing page' row in Table via keyboard sensor from position 1 to position 3 (resulting order: Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team). Separately in Cards view (also unsorted), dragged the same card to a different resulting position (Review, Update, Prepare, Team, Design). Switching back to Table confirmed it kept its own order (Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team), unaffected by the Cards reorder — each view retains independent manual order.

issue: No filtering feature exists in the application
actual: Searched the entire visible UI (header toolbar, column headers, card headers, Fields dialog) and inspected the DOM for any element with 'filter' in its class, aria-label, title, or text content — none found. document.body.innerHTML contains no occurrence of the word 'filter'. Only Search, Sort, Table/Cards toggle, and Add Entry controls are present. There is no way to define field-specific filter criteria.

issue: No filtering feature exists to verify inclusion/exclusion criteria
actual: Same as FT-6: no filter UI or functionality is present anywhere in the app, so filter criteria cannot be defined, applied, or cleared.

evidence: Typing 'marketing' filtered from 5 to 1 entry ('Review marketing materials'), footer updated to '1 entry matching \"marketing\"'. Typing 'MARKETING' (uppercase) gave the same single-match result, confirming case-insensitivity. Clearing the search via the clear (x) button restored all 5 entries and footer text.

issue: Quick search does not match formatted date or checkbox display values
actual: Searching 'Jan 15' (the exact formatted Due Date text shown for 'Design new landing page') returned 0 entries ('No entries found'). Searching 'Yes' (the exact formatted Completed value shown for 2 entries) also returned 0 entries. Search appears to only match the Task Name text field, not the displayed/formatted values of date or checkbox fields.

evidence: Priority is a native number input. Pressing letter key 'a' while focused left the value unchanged at '0' (verified via DOM read), and typing non-numeric text via fill() was rejected outright by Playwright due to input type=number constraint. Entering valid number 42 and submitting saved and displayed 'Validation Test Entry' with Priority=42 correctly.

Due Date is a native date input. Programmatically setting an invalid date string '2026-13-45' (invalid month/day) resulted in the input value being rejected/cleared to empty string. Entering a valid date 2026-10-05 and submitting saved and displayed the entry with Due Date='Oct 5, 2026' correctly.

Added text field 'Remarks' with no value set on any entry. Table view consistently displayed '—' for every entry's empty Remarks cell. Earlier test with 'Notes' field showed the same '—' placeholder consistently in both Table cells and Card view's labeled field rows. All other populated field values (Task Name, Priority, Due Date, Completed) matched exactly between Table and Card views for every entry.

issue: No data import feature exists in the application
actual: Searched the entire UI including the Configure Fields dialog (which only shows a note stating 'Configure fields before importing data') for an import control. Enumerated all buttons and file inputs on the page — no 'Import' button, file picker, or any import-related control exists anywhere in the app. Data cannot be imported at all.
